independent_replay.method: Copied the sealed F1-EVIDENCE.py and inputs/ordinary_tree_checked.py into a temporary subdirectory of this worker scratch, redirected the replay copy to that local copy, ran the prescribed Python 3.11 executable, compared the generated JSON byte-for-byte with the sealed F1-EVIDENCE.json, then removed the temporary copies.

ulc_reference_check.gurvits: Theorem 1.1 states convolution closure for ULC sequences with the orders added; Definition (2) allows order at least the sequence degree.
ulc_reference_check.saumard_wellner: Theorem 4.1(b) states convolution closure for ultra-log-concave distributions.
ulc_reference_check.scope: Confirms only the cited convolution/order point; does not validate every factor premise or its application to the whole family candidate.

exact_scope_and_fences.retained_scope: The stated finite coefficient replay, m=400 exact rational endpoint arithmetic, tiny m=1..3 graph-polynomial cross-checks, and the narrow ULC reference point as described in the source claim.
exact_scope_and_fences.not_established: Uniform analytic tail bounds, every large-m mixed-minor constant, selector propagation to all eligible ranks, full weighted aggregate, or any arbitrary-tree assertion.
exact_scope_and_fences.standing_controls: Positive T22 local contribution blocks a pointwise shortcut; the route does not claim a pointwise theorem. Its checks do not expand the T_m family scope or decide the primary open aggregate.

packet_hash_audit: All 4 case pins and 237 common pins matched their listed SHA-256 values before source review.
